rows.source_text: Goldens in Golden 2027 Your Guide to Dog Friendly Golden Pet-Friendly Lodging Options in Golden How to Spend a Perfect Weekend in Golden with Your Dog Golden’s Most Iconic Hikes Dog-Friendly Breweries in Golden Meet the Goldens Goldens in Golden – 2026 Highlights Goldens in Golden – Official Group Photos 2026 Goldens in Golden – Through The Years View & Download 2026 Group Photos FAQs About Goldens in Golden When and where is the event? Goldens in Golden is held every February. The 2027 event is scheduled for Saturday, February 6th from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. The main gathering takes place in downtown Golden, centered on Washington Avenue under the Welcome Arch, in Parfet Park, and in the lots between Arapahoe Street and Miners Alley. Do I need tickets? No tickets are required. Attendance is completely free. Are all dogs allowed? Friendly, leashed dogs of any breed are welcome to join the celebration. While Golden Retrievers may be the star of the show, all doggos all welcome! Where should I park? Convenient FREE parking & dog-friendly shuttles will run in 2027 until 5 p.m. with more information available as the event draws closer. Parking is also available in garages and surface lots throughout Downtown Golden; please read posted signs and register your vehicles as required to avoid ticketing. Where is the rideshare drop-off and pick-up? We’ve designated 907 Archer St, Golden, CO 80401 , by the Clear Creek parking lot as the official rideshare zone for Goldens in Golden. It’s convenient and gets you to the event in under 2 minutes. Return to the same location for easy pick-up when the event ends. Is the event weather-dependent? The event is rain, snow, or shine. In the case of severe weather, a public safety concern, or other circumstances beyond the City’s reasonable control, the City may modify or cancel portions of the event. Will there be water or rest areas? Bring plenty of water for you and your pup, and enjoy downtown’s dog-friendly patios! Explore local breweries, restaurants, shops, and relaxing benches throughout town with your four-legged friend. Where can I see this year’s group photo? rows.source_text: Full Moon Night Hike Tuesday, November 24, 2026 7:30 p.m. | In person at Join a Jeffco Parks & Open Space Ranger for a Full Moon program! Full Moon Night Hike Date: Tuesday, November 24th Time: 7:30pm- 9:30pm Program Location: South Valley Park — North Trailhead 8354 South Valley Road, Littleton, CO 80127 Description: Experience the park in a whole new light under the Full Moon! Join us for a nighttime hike as we explore the trails after dark, discover the sights and sounds of the nighttime landscape, and make our way up to Lyons Back for moon viewing. We will hike approximately 2.5 miles, following the Swallow Trail & Coyote Song Loop. The route includes approximately 300 feet of elevation gain from the trailhead. Additional Program info: What to Bring Sturdy hiking footwear Ice spikes — strongly recommended for potentially icy conditions Hiking poles (optional) Water Warm layers for cold evening temperatures Flashlight or headlamp (optional - we have headlamps to borrow) Snacks (optional) Weather conditions may be frosty, icy, or snowy , so please come prepared for winter trail conditions. Important: Please check your email during the week of the hike for updates. The program may be cancelled due to incoming weather, and any cancellation information will be communicated by email. Please leave pets at home. Age Group: 13+ with adult
